actions.title: Freeze public evidence support semantics
acceptance: Hidden truth is not an input to public support resolution
No bound is asserted without units, coverage, support and error assumptions

actions.title: Add session-level joint reachability
deliverables: joint feasibility witnesses under budget and deadlines
acceptance: Two independently reachable cost-1 tasks with budget 1 cannot both be declared jointly solvable
One shared cost-1 product can solve two targets without double charging

actions.title: Operationalize state and baseline causal controls
acceptance: Same ensemble mean but different relevant distribution is a content change
Mirror duplication is not a target-content change
All cutoff, invalidation and completion races are deterministic

actions.title: Prove one aligned regional multimodal chain
deliverables: sensor/model input and private outcome separation
acceptance: Use same actual region and time, with backlook and settlement tail
Routine slots are preregistered; missing is not a negative label
Source bytes, raw data QC and model traces are not interchangeable completion evidence

actions.title: Tighten novelty comparison and confirmation scope
deliverables: typed leakage grouping and missingness report
acceptance: Do not claim first multi-target rolling/selective forecasts
No outcome-derived target text or future-known selection signals
Full baseline, shared cache and cheap selectors included
16-class full release and earlier partial releases labelled separately
